title: 制御工学入門
subtitle: Introduction to Control Engineering
keywords: Complex numbers 2.Laplace transforms 3.Linear differential equations 4.Transfer functions 5.Block diagrams
educationalGoal: (1) Review complex numbers for frequency response. (2) Learn Laplace transforms for solving linear differential equations. (3) Acquire the capability to formulate transfer functions and block diagrams.
advice: This is a basic course in control engineering. We will mainly cover the following topics: 1. Calculation using complex numbers and Laplace transforms. 2. Solving linear differential equations using inverse Laplace transforms. 3. Obtaining transfer functions from differential equations and block diagrams. Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to be aware of the instructor's messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of Engineering Mechanics I/II and Electric Circuit I/II. Basic knowledge of differential calculus.

activityGoals.body: Solve linear differential equations with inverse Laplace transforms.
Obtain transfer functions from differential equations.
Obtain transfer functions from block diagrams.
